verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents Durable Workflows and CPU-time (not wall-time) billing that could support long-running, checkpointed agent state (cloudflare-docs-9, cloudflare-docs-15), but community evidence directly disputes practical fit for persistent agent runtimes, citing CPU-time caps (15min even on paid) and citing self-hosting as the actual solution for long-running agent workloads (cloudflare-comm-9).
